title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Implemented globally by Trócaire’s Global Hub on Partnership and Localisation, the programme contributes to outcome 6.1 Trócaire fulfils its commitment to localisation while inspiring sectoral transformation in solidarity with local actors. The objective is to provide more tailored and responsive capacity strengthening to local and national partners. Key activities include the revision/development of new capacity strengthening tools and training materials for Trócaire staff; roll out of the revised capacity strengthening approach at country level; and pilot initiatives at country level to support specific and contextual capacity strengthening needs. OBJECTIVES: 6.1.2: Evolved and more responsive capacity strengthening support by Trócaire for local and national partnersOUTCOMES:
